blocked_by.why: `creationDate.year` is a GROUP KEY and a calendar year is not a fixed stride from the epoch, so §2.7's exclusion of non-uniform calendar units is row-determining: without it the answer has no year dimension at all. R4 → BLOCKED.
blocked_by.notes: SPEC DELTA, verdict unchanged: §8.3's ATOMIC `mean` absorbs `sum(length)/toFloat(count(message))` — bi-1.cypher's averageMessageLength — which B1 counted as `arithmetic-over-aggregates`. The label survives on `messageCount / totalMessageCount`, an aggregate broadcast from a different relation, and it was never the row-determining residual anyway. See FREEZE §7.3.
